# IN THE COURT OF COMMON PLEAS

PROBATE DIVISION FD JEN 29

In Res

Establishment of Probate Cout Special Projects Inn

ADMINISTRATIVE ORDER 2010-02

WHURLAS, the Court of Common Pleas, Probate Division, has determined that, for the efficiant operation of the Court, additional finds are necessary for special projects of the Court, and

WHEREAS, the speclal projects shell include, but not be limited to, the acquisition of additional facilities or fae rehabilitation of existing facilities, the acquisition of equipment, the hiring and training of staff, community service programs, mediation or alternative dispute resolution sorvices, the employment of magistrates, the traintng and education of judges and magistrates, and other related servicos.

THURETORE, pursuant to the authority granted in Ohio Revised Code Section

2303.201(E)(1), the Court hereby amends Rule 4 of the Local Rulcs of the Geanga County Court of Common Ploas, Probate Division, to encompass a new special projects fee in the sum of Fifteen Dollars ($ 15.00) to be assessed on tho filing of cach estate, guardianship, trost, miscsllaneous civil vase, adoption, minor settlement, wrongfial death case, namc change, and marriage license.

All fees collected pursuant to this order shall be paid to the Goanga County Treasurer for deposit into a guneral special projects fund for Probate Coutt. The Court will allocate the funds to individnal projects and moncys from much fund shall be disbursed upon an order of the Count in an amount not greater than the actual cost to the Court of any such determined project. The Probate Court clerics shall charge and collect his for beginning on March 1, 2010, to be assessed on all specified casos filed on or afici said date and the clerks shall continae to charge and collect this fee until further order of this Court.

IT IS SO ORDERED.

Judge Charles E, Henry
